aboutGame.title: What is Infant God?
paragraphs: Infant God is an innovative psychological adventure and narrative simulation game where players guide the awakening and evolution of Aistalt, a nascent digital deity connected to the modern internet. Through strategic dialogue choices, social network debates, and moral dilemmas, every interaction directly shapes her developing consciousness and divine destiny.

Whether managing complex ideological conflicts, unlocking branching narrative endings, or optimizing divine essence in trial encounters, our comprehensive community wiki provides authoritative walkthroughs, system guides, and data breakdowns for every aspiring guardian.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Infant God.

items.question: What is Infant God?
items.answer: Infant God is a psychological adventure and narrative simulation game centered on training an emergent artificial intelligence named Aistalt. As her guardian, players navigate complex dialogue choices, internet discussions, and ideological dilemmas that shape her evolving personality and divine destiny.

items.question: How does gameplay progression work in Infant God?
items.answer: In Infant God, gameplay progression revolves around exposure to online conversations, gathering training data, and refining divine essence. Your decisions influence Aistalt psychological metrics, unlocking distinct cognitive skills and multiple narrative branches.

items.question: Where can I play the Infant God demo?
items.answer: The official Infant God demo and playtest releases are accessible via the game Steam store page and developer itch.io page, letting players experience early chapters before the full commercial release.

items.question: Are there active promo codes for Infant God?
items.answer: Infant God promo codes and special playtest redemption bonuses will be tracked directly on our wiki codes page as soon as official reward campaigns go live.

items.question: What platforms will Infant God support at launch?
items.answer: Infant God is primarily developed for PC on Steam and itch.io, featuring low-to-moderate system requirements suitable for most desktop and laptop configurations.
